input.message: Write me an itinerary for my dog's birthday party

default_example.output:
Title: Paw-some Dog Birthday Party Itinerary

Introduction:
Hello there! I'm thrilled to help you plan a fun-filled birthday party for your furry friend. As a responsible and caring assistant, I've created a comprehensive itinerary that ensures a safe, enjoyable, and memorable celebration for your dog. Please review the following schedule and feel free to adjust it according to your pup's unique needs and preferences.

1. Pre-Party Preparations:
a. Decorations: Set the mood with colorful balloons, streamers, and a personalized banner with your dog's name and photo.
b. Music: Play some upbeat tunes that your dog will enjoy, like "Happy" by Pharrell Williams or "Pup-Tastic" by The Animal Fair.
c. Games and Activities: Plan some engaging games and activities that are suitable for your dog's age, breed, and energy level. Examples include doggy obstacle courses, fetch, and musical sits.
d. Treats and Goodies: Prepare a variety of healthy treats and toys to reward your dog throughout the party. You can also set up a "Pup-Cake" station where guests can decorate their own doggy treats.
2. Welcome and Introduction (10:00 AM - 10:15 AM):
a. Greet your guests and introduce your dog.
b. Give a brief speech expressing your gratitude for your dog's unconditional love and loyalty.
c. Encourage guests to interact with your dog and get acquainted.
3. First Activity: Musical Sits (10:15 AM - 10:30 AM):
a. Play some upbeat music and have your dog sit on command.
b. Gradually increase the distance between you and your dog to test their obedience.
c. Offer treats and praise for successful attempts.
4. Second Activity: Doggy Obstacle Course (10:30 AM - 11:15 AM):
a. Set up a simple obstacle course using items like tunnels, cones, and jumps.
b. Guide your dog through the course, encouraging them to jump, run, and play.
c. Cheer on your dog as they complete the course, and offer support when needed.
5. Third Activity: Fetch (11:15 AM - 11:30 AM):
a. Choose your dog's favorite toy or fetch item.
b. Play a game of fetch, encouraging your dog to run, jump, and catch.
c. End the game with plenty of praise and treats for your dog's efforts.
6. Pup-Cake Decorating Station (11:30 AM - 12:00 PM):
a. Provide plain doggy treats or cookies for guests to decorate.
b. Offer various toppings, such as yogurt, peanut butter, and sprinkles.
c. Encourage creativity and have fun decorating the treats together.
7. Lunchtime (12:00 PM - 1:00 PM):
a. Serve a nutritious and delicious meal for your dog, such as a homemade dog food or a high-quality commercial brand.
b. Offer plenty of fresh water and a special treat or two during the meal.
8. Fourth Activity: Trick Training (1:00 PM - 1:30 PM):
a. Teach your dog a new trick, such as "shake," "stay," or "roll over."
b. Use positive reinforcement techniques, like treats and praise, to encourage learning.
c. Practice the trick together until your dog masters it.
9. Fifth Activity: Group Photo Shoot (1:30 PM - 2:00 PM):
a. Gather all the guests and their dogs for a group photo shoot.
b. Use fun props and backdrops to capture memorable moments.
c. Share the photos on social media, tagging your friends and family.
10. Closing Ceremony (2:00 PM - 2:15 PM):
a. Express your gratitude to your guests for attending your dog's birthday party.
b. Share some closing remarks, highlighting the importance of animal companionship and the joy our furry friends bring

top_p.description: When decoding text, samples from the top p percentage of most likely tokens; lower to ignore less likely tokens

max_length.title: Max Length
max_length.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate. A word is generally 2-3 tokens

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Adjusts randomness of outputs, greater than 1 is random and 0 is deterministic, 0.75 is a good starting value.

repetition_penalty.title: Repetition Penalty
repetition_penalty.description: Penalty for repeated words in generated text; 1 is no penalty, values greater than 1 discourage repetition, less than 1 encourage it.
